:::{#thm-channel-coding}
#### Noisy-channel coding theorem

Let $C$ be the [capacity](#def-channel-capacity)
of a [discrete memoryless channel](#def-channel).

1. For every [rate](#def-code-rate) $R < C$ there is a [sequence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-sequence) of
   $(\lceil 2^{nR} \rceil, n)$ [channel codes](#def-channel-code),
   for $n = 1, 2, \dots$,
   whose [maximal probability of error](#def-maximal-probability-of-error)
   $\lambda^{(n)}$ tends to $0$.

2. Conversely, any sequence of $(\lceil 2^{nR} \rceil, n)$ codes
   with $\lambda^{(n)} \to 0$ has $R \le C$.

:::
